offseason_methods.reset: windows start fresh each season; fewer than k games that season = no value
offseason_methods.mean_regress: carried games pulled toward their season's league average: value -> avg + 0.50^(seasons back) x (value - avg)
offseason_methods.decay: carried games keep their value with weight 0.50^(seasons back) in the window mean; current-season games weigh 1
offseason_methods.season_to_date: mean of earlier games this season; under mean_regress/decay the first game uses the previous season (regressed / equal weights)

meta.opponent_adjustment: game value minus the opponent's mean over its earlier games this season (its whole previous season before its first game)
meta.elo: production walk-forward (tools/elo_model.R, ELO_K_FACTOR), every completed game from 2002, pregame ratings; expected margin = (Elo - opp Elo + 48 x home sign) / 25

stronger_arm.selection_rule: shortest window (1..17, season-to-date treated as longest) whose point score lies inside the 95% team-season block bootstrap interval of the best window's score

weights.standardisation: z-score across teams within each season-week (at least 10 teams)
weights.score: pooled held-out (LOSO) R^2 of margin beyond Elo from a one-variable linear map of the combined score fitted on training seasons

flags.note: SIMULATED detection rates: a methods check, not published data

one_score.label: One-score record vs expected
one_score.test: binomial z: wins in one-score games (|margin| <= 8, ties half) vs 0.5

pythagorean.label: Pythagorean vs actual
pythagorean.test: binomial z: wins vs the Pythagorean expectation (exponent 2.37; tested at p0 = 0.5)
pythagorean.effect_basis: 90th percentile of |team-season win share - Pythagorean share|

fumble_recovery.label: Fumble-recovery rate
fumble_recovery.test: binomial z: share of all fumbles in the team's games recovered by the team vs 0.5

opp_fg_pct.label: Opponent field-goal %
opp_fg_pct.test: binomial z: opponents' field goals made vs the league rate (0.846)
opp_fg_pct.effect_basis: 90th percentile of |team-season opponent FG% - league FG% that season|

turnover_margin.label: Turnover margin vs season level
turnover_margin.test: Poisson z: window takeaways minus giveaways vs the team's season level (variance 2 x league giveaways per game)
turnover_margin.effect_basis: 90th percentile of |team-season turnover margin per game|

blowout_skew.label: Blowout skew
blowout_skew.test: binomial z: share of games decided by 17+ points vs the league rate (0.259)
blowout_skew.effect_basis: 90th percentile of |team-season blowout share - league share|

opponent_strength.label: Opponent strength
opponent_strength.test: z: mean opponent pregame Elo vs the league mean that season, game-to-game SD within team-seasons
opponent_strength.effect_basis: 90th percentile of |team-season mean opponent Elo - league mean|

rest_bye.label: Rest / bye share
rest_bye.test: z: mean rest-day difference (team minus opponent, within season) vs 0, game-to-game SD within team-seasons

key_players_missing.label: Key players missing
key_players_missing.test: binomial z: key player-games missed vs the league rate (0.093); key = the team-season's 22 players with most snaps
key_players_missing.effect_basis: 90th percentile of |team-season key player-games missed share - league share|
key_players_missing.caveat: player-games are not independent (one injury spans several games), so this test overstates detection
